description: Start a real instant quote with carriers (CoverForce markets). Returns quoteId and the carriers' questions, prefilled from agent_answers. Files nothing until submit_quote_answers. No API key.

agent_answers.description: Facts you found with your user's permission. Labelled agent-supplied and cited on the quote. Never tax ids, SSNs, dates of birth or license numbers.

field.description: Field name from quote_needs (e.g. annual_revenue) or intent:<name>

coverages.description: Coverage lines, e.g. ["general_liability", "workers_comp", "bop", "property", "cyber", "professional_liability", "commercial_auto", "umbrella", "management_liability"]. management_liability quotes D&O, EPL, fiduciary and crime together; executive_liability, employment_practices, fiduciary_liability and crime quote one part

name: start_quote
title: Start a real carrier quote
